title: Emit capacity recovery lifecycle checkpoints
requires: Any development host plus one production driver implementing liquid resources
scope: Make the existing public-API resource-lifecycle fixture emit the four formal capacity-replacement-recovery observations required by adverse-capacity-three-family-v1. Fingerprint only canonical public identity and observable state; use harness ordinals for generations and never expose private handles, timings or diagnostics.
acceptance: Standalone and embedded conformance paths execute one shared capacity/replacement/overflow/recovery operation sequence and retain the existing exact-capacity stress coverage.

The result contains baseline, replacement, overflow and recovery observations with exact outcomes, active state, deterministic generation ordinals and canonical state SHA-256 values for both target-fluid and unrelated-fluid.

conformance/v1/lifecycle.py passes the capacity-replacement-recovery case on CUDA and Vulkan from one clean Linux revision; unsupported drivers remain explicitly unsupported and no lifecycle profile rule is weakened.
